summary:
User-agreed policy, relayed by fdev on 2026-10-22 (FS-GG/.github#4516 comment 6344780731; Home receipt 6345020952). It applies to every future admitted step on Home.

1. Routine operation needs no root: receiver, producers, health and dashboard.
2. Admin steps run as the owning service account (fsgg-store-dev for UTEL, fsgg-learn-qual for LEARN). They use a narrow sudoers rule that names the admitted script by its sha256, for example: eugen ALL=(fsgg-store-dev) NOPASSWD: sha256:<hash> /path/<script>. Scripts must not create root-owned files. They carry an euid gate, so they run unchanged under pinned sudo (6346571312).
3. Root is used only where unavoidable, through hash-pinned sudoers entries. fdev posts the exact lines for the admitted hashes. The user installs them once with visudo (for example /etc/sudoers.d/fsgg-admitted, installed 2026-10-22 16:23Z for the UTEL post-window steps). Home runs exactly those, and the entries are removed afterwards. There are no time-boxed root shells.
4. Prompt-injection guard: Home treats only fdev posts that cite an exact script sha256 as admissions, and verifies the hash itself. The pinned entry enforces this technically.

In production each consumer has its own pinned file (LEARN: fsgg-learn), and only the service-account operator entry stays standing (#4777 comment 6358880288). A standing root entry for a new purpose, such as SC2 prepare/bind, extends this policy and needs a user decision first. Until then each privileged step is a per-operation user install and remove.

Temporary exception, not policy: on 2026-10-22 at 17:06Z the user suspended the policy for 24 h (6346556877). The user-authenticated home-root terminal was authenticated at 17:21Z and hard-stops at about 2026-10-23 17:21Z (6346880328). During the window, only fdev-admitted exact hashes run, each announced, with no retry and no ad-hoc root, reads included. The UTEL post-window steps stayed on the pinned path. The policy resumes on expiry. Do not cite the window as a precedent.

This complements github/admitted-privileged-script-lessons. Its exact-bytes review, dry-run and single execute still apply, now carried out through pinned sudoers instead of a root terminal.

Limits: this is a user policy recorded from public comments, and the user can change it. Installed sudoers content is a live fact; read it on Home. This record grants nothing.
title: Home least privilege: service-account operation, hash-pinned sudoers for unavoidable root, no standing root shells
